Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation. Isolated Born–Oppenheimer nonrelativistic two-electron closed-shell H₂. Compare STO-3G and nested s-Gaussian spaces at three separations. Numerical RHF validation, not molecular DFT, periodic, complete-basis or correct-dissociation validation. Equations, figures and error analysis · Code ZIP for this example AssumptionsFixed nuclei, singlet restricted HF, one doubly occupied spatial orbital. Original Gaussian integrals and independent PySCF use identical geometries and bases.UnitsAtomic units: distances in bohr and total energies in hartree. Overlap, electron count and density normalization are specified in inputs/reading.Boundaries and model scopeIsolated finite molecule with whole-space Gaussian integrals; no periodic boundary or finite box.
